title: Assessment 3 — Self Avatar Introduction
source_document: MRU AICC Final Assessment Framework and Rubrics 2026.pdf

criteria.label: Avatar resemblance and presentation
criteria.official_description: Avatar is presented as the student's chosen digital self and suits a personal introduction.

criteria.label: Introduction content and clarity
criteria.official_description: The student introduces themself clearly and communicates relevant information understandably.

criteria.label: Delivery and communication
criteria.official_description: Speech, tone, pacing and presentation are appropriate and easy to follow.

criteria.label: Lip-sync and avatar motion
criteria.official_description: Lip-sync, facial movement and gestures are reasonably convincing and not repeatedly distracting.

criteria.label: Audio and intelligibility
criteria.official_description: Speech is audible and understandable, with manageable noise or distortion.

criteria.label: Visual quality and framing
criteria.official_description: Framing, background and image quality support a clear introduction.

criteria.label: Editing and final delivery
criteria.official_description: Video is complete, appropriately paced and presented as a finished submission.
